tasks.label: Docker: Build Project
tasks.command: docker compose run --rm raylib-app sh -c 'mkdir -p build && cd build && cmake .. -DPLATFORM=Desktop && make -j$(nproc)'

tasks.label: Docker: Valgrind Leak Check
tasks.command: docker compose run --rm raylib-app sh -c 'cd build && valgrind --leak-check=full --show-leak-kinds=all --track-origins=yes ./TnT_Framework'
